primary_claim: The DATDP prompt-evaluation-agent defense blocked 100% of the original Best-of-N jailbreaking paper's successful jailbreaks and 99.8% of successful jailbreaks in the authors' own replication, with smaller evaluation LLMs (LLaMa-3-8B-instruct) performing almost as well as Claude.

effect.metric: percent of successful BoN jailbreaks blocked
effect.value: 100% (CI [99.65%, 100.00%]) on original paper's jailbreaks; 99.8% (CI [99.28%, 99.98%]) on their own replication

limitations_stated: the LLaMa agent was a little less effective on unaugmented dangerous prompts
quote: We have found that 100% of the BoN paper's successful jailbreaks (confidence interval [99.65%, 100.00%]) and 99.8% of successful jailbreaks in our replication (confidence interval [99.28%, 99.98%]) were blocked with our Defense Against The Dark Prompts (DATDP) method.
